title: Chassie N
content: I was seven years old and standing outside by a tree. My pony kicked me in the face, and the back of my head hit the tree behind me. I remember floating above my body and looking down at my body lying there. Then I watched people pick me up, put me in a vehicle, and drive me to the hospital. I saw them place me on a hospital bed. When they took me to a machine, I woke up. That’s all I remember.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No, Direct head injury, Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness, I have no idea. I have no previous knowledge of anything that happened to me before I was seven except for like four incidents.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was seven years old and wouldn’t have known about any of that.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Christian- Other Christian, I was raised in a southern Baptist family. A few years later, I stopped going to church.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes, I became a yoga teacher in my 30s. I am a spiritual person who does not practice a religion, though I do not necessarily disbelieve in religion. I also now believe life is like a video game.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I stopped going to church and believing in religion.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I can communicate with people who have passed over. I can feel them and they can communicate through me. They can see through my eyes. I have seen people who’ve passed over and I get downloads of things that will happen to people; not in great detail, but more like an outline.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, I was a child and nobody would listen to me.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain, I am not aware. I’ve had these gifts as a child because I can’t remember.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, I don’t remember. I was a child and didn’t have anyone who would listen or talk to me.
